sweep_method: Three real sweeps beyond the mechanical gates, all re-run at this tip: (1) the round-1 U2c hard-block class — the contract's prescribed `git grep -n "logical_col(\|logical_expr::col\b\|Column::new_unqualified\|datafusion::prelude::col\b" -- crates/jammi-db/src crates/jammi-ai/src`, whose two residual col(..) sites both bind the engine-internal literal "_row_id" (never a projected or user-supplied name) and are therefore out of class, while both sort-key/projection builders use Expr::Column(Column::new_unqualified(..)); (2) every migration-name pin site via `git grep -n 035_instances_peer_addr_result_root` and the same for 034, four sites, all agreeing; (3) every TrainingSetStream open site via `git grep -n "TrainingSetStream::open\|open_streamed_source\|build_label_vocabulary"` to confirm none reaches a plan outside the re-applied tenant scope. Display/FromStr sites were enumerated from the diff itself rather than sampled.

No hard-block was raised, so there is no violation class to enumerate. Beyond the mechanical gates I swept three classes for siblings and found none: (a) every RPC on the wire — the diff adds/removes zero 'rpc ' declarations and api_freeze_baseline.txt is unchanged, so the new/changed-RPC set is empty and the tenant-denial obligation has no unmet member; (b) every migration in MIGRATIONS — git diff --name-status over the range shows only migrations.rs and tests/it/migrations.rs touched, no migration renamed, deleted or reordered, and all four K5 pin sites agree; (c) every Display/FromStr impl added in the range (three fmt impls, zero FromStr) plus WorkerState's untouched as_db_str encoding.

No hard-block violation was found, so there is no class to enumerate. Beyond the mechanical gates I swept three classes deliberately: (1) every rpc/service line in the proto diff (zero) plus every new READ entry point and tenant-scoped catalog read, to catch the esc-013 shape on a non-RPC surface — found sql_stream and list_gang_members, both oracled; (2) all call sites of the four cell extractors repo-wide (`grep -rn extract_string_column|extract_binary_column|extract_numeric_column|string_cells|binary_cells|DecodedBatch --include=*.rs crates/`) to confirm the eager and streamed paths share one policy and that eval/golden.rs's same-named helper is a separate pre-existing module; (3) mutation testing of both pump flushes in a private git-archive snapshot with its own target dir, since a flush that no test covers is indistinguishable from a correct one by reading alone. I also verified the cfg(feature="test-hooks") gate on mod gang_membership does not strand its tenant oracle — a plain run matched 0 of 484 tests, so I confirmed .github/workflows/ci.yml:211 runs that lane unconditionally and executed it (520 passed).
